# Tests of the JSON Schema Test Suite that this module is known to fail.
# TestSuite fails when a test outside this list fails, when a listed test
# passes, and when a listed test is no longer in the suite. This covers
# the required tests and the optional ones (optional/, optional/format/).
#
# Columns, separated by tabs: category, draft/file, group, test; an
# optional "# note" after a tab says what happened.
#
# Categories (README.md, "JSON Schema Test Suite", explains each):
#   integer-fraction-zero  a number with a zero fraction is an integer in
#                          every draft (draft-04 says otherwise); kept on
#                          purpose
integer-fraction-zero	draft4/optional/zeroTerminatedFloats	some languages do not distinguish between different types of numeric value	a float is not an integer even without fractional part	# accepted invalid data
